unresolved_contract_gaps.title: Closed RG-09 action registry and atomic outcomes
unresolved_contract_gaps.capability_boundary: The current registry lacks closed action/class branches for stale-preview rejection, zero-delta observation save, imported intake and sparse incomplete confirmation, source-aware imported confirmation, exact real-posting evidence binding, invalid-input rejection, and every originating-action retry represented by RG-09.
unresolved_contract_gaps.required_change: Register each missing action_type/operation_class pair with strict accepted/no-change input or rejected sparse attempted_input, exact outcome, complete named baseline/result states, typed returned IDs, exhaustive entity/value deltas, and retries that retain the originating action rather than a generic retry discriminator.
unresolved_contract_gaps.risk: Without closed actions, missing confirmation facts could be inferred, stale previews or invalid probes could gain partial effects, and retries could duplicate formal, intake, report, or reconciliation effects.

unresolved_contract_gaps.title: Mandatory replay fingerprint, stale diagnostics, and explicit validation contract
unresolved_contract_gaps.capability_boundary: D-065 SHA-256, projection, and stale-diagnostic shapes plus the private deterministic computation are frozen. No candidate or confirmation fingerprint field is exposed. Generation, candidate/input population, mandatory confirmation, stale-preview diagnostics, atomic rejection, and explicit counter-account/amount/explanation facts are not implemented.
unresolved_contract_gaps.required_change: When fixture and operation gates open together, add closed mandatory candidate and confirmation fields, generate a valid D-065 digest for every preview, migrate symbolic fixture tokens by recomputation, and add stale diagnostic and atomic rejection branches. Do not introduce optional safety fields or adjustment lifecycle payloads.
unresolved_contract_gaps.risk: Dropping these validation facts would permit confirmation against a stale replay or infer allocation/account facts that the frozen rule requires the user to confirm explicitly.

unresolved_contract_gaps.title: Imported-transfer source, candidate, and evidence provenance
unresolved_contract_gaps.capability_boundary: The current source, candidate, and evidence registries close explicit balance observations but not imported transfer candidate payloads, manual transfer-confirmation sources, account-statement sources, imported proposal requirements, or real-account posting evidence variants.
unresolved_contract_gaps.required_change: Register closed source, candidate, and evidence variants for immutable source digests and times, confidence and proposed transfer/allocation facts, required confirmations, account-statement evidence, and exact source/evidence lineage while preserving pending_confirmation until every fact is explicitly confirmed.
unresolved_contract_gaps.risk: Without closed provenance, imported or posting evidence could be mislabeled as a target observation or used to create a real transfer or reversal before explicit confirmation.
